admission.justification: Dropping index flags, intent-to-add or sparse entries during publication or refusal would lose staged work.

applicability: Index restoration across publication and refusal.
conditions: The index holds flags, intent-to-add entries or sparse-checkout entries a tree cannot record.
exclusions: Entries the caller staged for the commit itself; those follow the judged tree.
statement: Publication and refusal preserve index flags, intent-to-add entries outside the commit and sparse-checkout entries.
